title: Scale 블로그 시리즈 설계 (k3s 수평 스케일아웃)
summary: Design plan for a 9-part 'Scale' blog series on horizontally scaling the payment-cancel MSA on k3s, defining structure, scope, and success criteria.
notes: Lives in specs/ folder (SPEC path signal) but content has no technical-spec hallmarks (no APIs/schemas/SLOs). Dominant signals are explicit 목표(Goals)/범위 밖(Out of Scope)/성공 기준(Success criteria) → PRD-style requirements for a content deliverable. Domain is editorial (blog series), not the payment software itself. Not an ADR: '상태: 설계 확정' is not an Accepted/Proposed status field and there is no single decision+consequences structure. Could alternatively be DOC (design/planning prose).
